entry.title: PHP2Shell Vulnerabilities in Siemens Software Products

summary.content: On October 21, 2026, the PHP project and security researchers disclosed two critical, unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities in the core PHP language runtime known as "php2shell" (tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). This advisory covers the status of impact of various Siemens software products.

Siemens is currently assessing the impact of NGINX2Root (CVE-2026-123007, CVE-2026-123633, CVE-2026-123634, CVE-2026-121810, CVE-2026-113425) on Industrial Edge.

Siemens is preparing fixes and recommends specific mitigations for products where fixes are not or not yet available.

On November 17, 2026, the OpenJDK project released security updates addressing a critical vulnerability in the hardware-accelerated Base64 decoder in the OpenJDK HotSpot JVM, commonly referred to as "Java4Shell" (tracked as CVE-2026-114938). The vulnerability is a heap-based out-of-bounds write that could allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause memory corruption and potentially execute arbitrary code. 

__For your system to be exposed to this vulnerability, all of the following conditions must be met:__  

* An affected JVM. Including Java runtimes bundled inside products.
* Intel and AMD chips are affected in case they support a x86-64 CPU architecture with AVX-512 VBMI
* Untrusted Base64 reaching Base64.getDecoded() or getUrlDecoded()
* A JIT-compiled decoder  

Siemens is preparing fixes and recommends specific mitigations for products where fixes are not or not yet available.  

This advisory covers the status of impact of various Siemens products.
